WITH filtered_income AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, amount
  FROM income
  WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
),
member_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    SUM(amount) as member_sum
  FROM filtered_income
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_sum) as total_sum
  FROM member_totals
),
member_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    member_sum,
    CAST(member_sum AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_sum FROM grand_total) as share
  FROM member_totals
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM member_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    member_sum,
    share
  FROM member_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_calc)
)
SELECT
  SUM(member_sum) as total_of_summed_amounts,
  AVG(share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_calc)) as average_share_minus_avg
FROM above_average
